Subject: Special comp package request for Ethan Park — initial packet

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Following Ethan's year-end review (summary attached), I am proposing a one-time retention bonus and an equity refresh outside the normal cycle. Quick summary:
- Role: Senior ML Engineer (Ethan Park)
- Rationale: led cross-team caching optimization that reduced inference cost by ~27% and shipped the KV-cache fallback that prevented two production incidents. Impact tied to revenue ops and direct savings to Dedicated customers.
- Ask: $25,000 one-time cash retention; 1,500 RSU equity refresh (4-year cliff/3-year vest schedule to be worked out if approved); title uplift to Principal Engineer pending org confirmation.

Attachments: comp-case-ethan-20261117.pdf, impact-dossier.zip, ethan_comp_calc.xlsx

Budget owner: Platform Eng (cost center 4102). We believe this is a time-sensitive retention risk — the candidate has multiple inbound offers.

Can you confirm what approvals are required and whether Finance/Exec sign-off will be needed for the equity size? If we can get a path this week, I will prepare a 1-pager for the comp committee.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — huge impact and thank you for pulling the docs together. A few clarifying items before I escalate:
1) Can you confirm Ethan's current band and base comp? (I want to understand headroom for title bump before we propose a new band.)
2) Is the $25k gross or net? Do we intend to pay in a single lump sum or installments?
3) Any probationary constraints (onboarding date / promo eligibility) that would block an immediate RSU grant?

Aditya — looping you in for quick budget confirmation and any Finance constraints. If you can flag any treasury/captable concerns I will include them in the packet.

Jonas

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the packet. Quick process notes from People Ops:
- Equity: our policy requires exec approval for any off-cycle grant > 1,000 RSUs. That will need the CEO or CFO sign-off and a short one-page business rationale.
- Cash: bonuses above $20k need CFO approval and Finance confirmation on funding source / cost code.
- Title changes outside the annual cycle require org sign-off (we'll coordinate with Talent Mobility).

Please complete the exec-approval-form (attached) with the justification and risk analysis. If you want, I can present the case to the comp committee on Friday — but I need the completed form plus the impact & candidate risk summary.

Laura

Reviewed the ask. High level: Finance can provisionally approve the cash retention ($25,000) provided Platform Eng identifies an offset (either hiring freeze in Q1 or reallocation of contractor budget). Please mark cost center 4102 and prepare a revised forecast impact doc.

On equity: a 1,500 RSU refresh is material from a cap table and reporting perspective. We'll need Treasury to confirm available pool and vesting cadence compatibility; cc'ing FinPay to confirm whether this grant configuration is supported by payroll/tools for off-cycle grants.

FinPay team — can you confirm: 1) ability to run an off-cycle RSU grant with a 3-year vest schedule, 2) any payroll/tax timing constraints we should be aware of if grant is executed before year-end?

If both cash and equity are workable, I can offer conditional approval subject to final packet and exec sign-off for the equity.

Thanks,
Aditya

Thanks everyone — quick update and proposed plan:
- Marissa will fill out the exec-approval-form today and attach the revised forecast (Marissa: please show the proposed offset lines).
- Aditya: thanks for provisional cash approval; we will document the offset and route the final packet to you.
- Laura: if you can schedule a 10-minute slot on Friday's comp committee call, that would be ideal.
- Emma (PeopleOps Partner): can you run a brief market benchmark (30–60 min) to validate the equity ask vs. market for senior/lead ML engineers in SF? If you can share a short note by EOD Friday, that would help the committee.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.pdf (timeline and owners). Once we have the completed exec form, Aditya's final sign-off and Treasury confirmation, Laura can forward to Exec for signature.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 11/20 EOD: Marissa uploads completed form + offset forecast + Emma benchmark note
- Mon 11/23: Comp committee decision; if approved, Finance/Treasury and People Ops to finalize grant mechanics

Jonas
